actovegin: Calf-blood preparation; its constituents are not represented by one defined peptide.
adamantylaminoethyl-chlorophenoxyacetate: SU1771186A1 concerns an aminoethyl ester hydrochloride; ADK-957 denotes a different chemical lead.
adk-559: Adamantylpiperazine screening code; the substitution pattern awaits the original chemistry record.
adk-591: Adamantylpiperazine screening code; the substitution pattern awaits the original chemistry record.
adk-613: The dissertation transcription associates this code with an adamantyl para-fluoroaniline hydrochloride.
adk-676: Adamantylpiperazine screening code; the substitution pattern awaits the original chemistry record.
adk-677: Adamantylpiperazine screening code; the substitution pattern awaits the original chemistry record.
adk-829: Certificate 1116699 concerns a benzoyl/para-bromophenyl aminoadamantane; this code is not ADK-918.
adk-918: The identified benzamide is N-(adamantan-2-yl)-4-bromobenzamide; Bromantane denotes a different structure.
adk-957: Chlorophenoxyacetamide lead in adamantane chemistry; the original pharmacology remains an acquisition target.
adk-963: The dissertation assigns this code to an ortho-hydroxyphenyl aminoadamantane; exact stereochemistry needs verification.
awe18: Cyclic Ala/Glu/Trp candidate; research on CP-88 must be evaluated separately.
b-300: Experimental formulation containing Bemitil and Trekrezan. Binavit is a different preparation.
bemitil: Benzimidazole compound; the names bemethyl and Metaprot also occur in its research literature.
binavit: Injectable B1/B6/B12 and lidocaine formulation. Broader B-vitamin studies do not automatically concern this formulation.
bonomarlot: Bone-marrow extract preparation; neither synthetic Stemokin nor historical Haemalin is treated as interchangeable.
bonothyrk: Parathyroid preparation lead; source recovery and formulation characterization are pending.
bromantane: Adamantane small molecule associated with the name Ladasten in fatigue-related research.
bromitil: Historical tablet combining Bromantane with Bemitil, identified through a pharmacokinetic dissertation.
bronchogen: Four-residue peptide catalogue entry associated with bronchial research.
camphane-aniline-4e: Para-ethylphenyl camphane amine designated 4e in the 2024 paper; the designation is paper-specific.
camphane-chlorobenzamide: Chlodantane-related chemistry using a camphane cage rather than an adamantane cage.
cardiogen: Four-residue peptide catalogue entry associated with myocardial research.
cartalax: AED (Ala–Glu–Asp), also indexed as T-31. The cartilage extract PCC is a separate preparation.
cerebrolysin: Brain-derived mixture containing peptides and amino acids; its literature is separate from Cortexin and isolated peptides.
cerluten: Tissue preparation with an institute-report source trail; formulation-specific appraisal remains pending.
chelohart: Tissue preparation with an institute-report source trail; formulation-specific appraisal remains pending.
chitomur: Bladder-tissue preparation lead; the original report and composition remain acquisition targets.
chlodantane: N-(adamantan-2-yl)-4-chlorobenzamide. Its benzamide linkage differs from Bromantane's arylamine linkage.
chonluten: Three-residue peptide catalogue entry associated with respiratory research.
cortagen: Four-residue peptide catalogue entry associated with brain research; Cortexin is a separate preparation.
cortexin: Preparation obtained from animal cerebral cortex, comprising multiple small peptides.
cp-88: Cyclic candidate designated cyclo-{E(I)-E(W)}Na in hematopoietic research.
crystagen: Product reports describe Glu, Asp and Pro constituents; equivalence to a defined EDP intervention requires characterization.
cyclontane: ADK-638, identified as 1-hydroxy-4-cyclohexylaminoadamantane hydrochloride; sodium-oxybate combinations require separate records.
dsip: Nine-residue peptide indexed as Trp–Ala–Gly–Gly–Asp–Ala–Ser–Gly–Glu; its sleep-related name is not proof of human efficacy.
edl: Glu–Asp–Leu candidate in renal culture research. AED/Cartalax is a different sequence.
endoluten: Tissue preparation with an institute-report source trail; formulation-specific appraisal remains pending.
epitalon: Synthetic AEDG tetrapeptide; Epithalamin denotes a pineal-tissue extract rather than this sequence.
epithalamin: Pineal extract containing multiple peptides; findings cannot automatically be assigned to synthetic Epitalon.
etomerzol: Thiobenzimidazole candidate appearing in rat hypoxia and laboratory oxidation research.
glandokort: Tissue preparation with an institute-report source trail; formulation-specific appraisal remains pending.
gotratix: Tissue preparation with an institute-report source trail; formulation-specific appraisal remains pending.
haemalin: Historical marrow-derived mixture; the modern Bonomarlot record is separate.
ked: Sequence designation for Lys–Glu–Asp, also associated with Vesugen in the catalogue.
kemantane: Adamantane preparation used as a comparator in immune-pharmacology research.
libidon: Product or peptide name requiring composition and source-document verification.
livagen: KEDA (Lys–Glu–Asp–Ala) in the linked review; Ventvil denotes a liver extract rather than this sequence.
noopept: Pro–Gly-derived N-phenylacetyl-L-prolylglycine ethyl ester; also designated GVS-111 or omberacetam.
normophthal: Two-residue peptide catalogue entry associated with retinal research.
ogp: Fourteen-residue histone-H4-related peptide; marrow extracts and shorter OGP fragments are separate interventions.
ovagen: Product reports name Glu, Asp and Leu; equivalence to a defined EDL peptide needs preparation-specific characterization.
pancragen: Four-residue peptide catalogue entry associated with pancreatic research.
pcc: Cartilage extract containing multiple peptides; detection of AED does not make the extract equivalent to synthetic Cartalax.
phenotropil: Name associated with phenylpiracetam/fonturacetam and historical Carphedon; a phenyl-substituted racetam.
picamilon: Nicotinoyl-GABA small molecule in Russian nootropic literature.
pielotax: Tissue preparation with an institute-report source trail; formulation-specific appraisal remains pending.
pinealon: Synthetic EDR tripeptide in neuronal and gene-regulation research.
pirabel: Piracetam–Bemitil combination; results cannot be assigned to either constituent alone.
piracetam: Racetam small molecule associated with Nootropil, also studied in historical fatigue-related combinations.
prostamax: Four-residue peptide catalogue entry associated with prostate research.
prostatilen: Prostate extract preparation; the defined short-peptide Prostamax entry is separate.
retinalamin: Retinal extract preparation; Normophthal denotes a different catalogue entry.
selank: Synthetic tuftsin-related peptide in anxiety and neurobiology research.
semax: Synthetic ACTH-fragment-related peptide in neurological research.
sigumir: Tissue preparation with an institute-report source trail; formulation-specific appraisal remains pending.
stamakort: Stomach-tissue preparation lead; original composition and report verification are pending.
stemokin: IEW (Ile–Glu–Trp), associated with the Neogen name; separate from whole-tissue extracts.
suprefort: Tissue preparation with an institute-report source trail; formulation-specific appraisal remains pending.
svetinorm: Tissue preparation with an institute-report source trail; formulation-specific appraisal remains pending.
tactivin: Thymus extract, also designated T-activin; evidence depends on preparation and clinical setting.
taxorest: Tissue preparation with an institute-report source trail; formulation-specific appraisal remains pending.
testagen: Catalogue designation whose sequence and preparation-specific research remain unresolved.
testoluten: Testicular-tissue preparation lead; original composition and report verification are pending.
thymalin: Thymus-derived peptide mixture rather than a single synthetic peptide.
thymodepressin: Glu–Trp-derived dipeptide candidate; stereochemistry and linkage must be specified when comparing experiments.
thymogen: Two-residue peptide catalogue entry associated with immune-regulation research.
thymohaemin: Historical preparation combining thymus and marrow material.
thymohexin: Six-residue candidate in irradiation-related hematopoietic research; conflicting Asp/Asn sequence assignments need original chemistry.
tireogen: Product or peptide name requiring composition and source-document verification.
trekrezan: Oxyethylammonium methylphenoxyacetate small molecule; also present in experimental B-300 formulations.
vasolin: Calf-vessel polypeptide extract associated with Slavinorm; it is separate from isolated KED.
vasonin: Vascular-wall preparation lead; its relationship to Vasolin awaits original documentation.
ventfort: Tissue preparation with an institute-report source trail; formulation-specific appraisal remains pending.
ventvil: Liver polypeptide extract; Livagen/KEDA denotes a distinct intervention.
vesugen: KED (Lys–Glu–Asp) in the catalogue; vessel extracts are separate preparations.
vilon: Two-residue peptide catalogue entry associated with regeneration research.
vilosen: Thymic preparation in radiation-injury literature; it is distinct from the Vilon dipeptide.
vinpotropil: Piracetam–vinpocetine fixed combination; studies cannot isolate an individual constituent's effect.
visoluten: Eye-tissue preparation lead; original composition and report verification are pending.
vladonix: Tissue preparation with an institute-report source trail; formulation-specific appraisal remains pending.
zhenoluten: Ovarian-tissue preparation lead; original composition and report verification are pending.
